This is an option for the player who wants to play with the server (especially dedicated server) where turned off DoLuaChecksum option .
This option does not change server settings or affect singleplayer and will persist even if you close the game.

Cheat menu: RB is disabled to prevent hacking accidents.
All active cheats have been disabled.
Once per in-game day at noon (or on the first update after noon), save both character progress and equipment. Restore them separately. Single player.
Best-effort installation of all optional armor, racks, bars, bumpers and other tuning parts exposed by the selected vehicle mod.
Every in-game day at 12:00 the menu automatically updates the saved skills and character statistics.
LMB or Z applies the selected wood/metal barricade to doors/windows on the square. Set material and plank count in Brush settings.
Opens the advanced brush tool, if available.
Creative unlocks build and craft actions. Each action receives its own temporary full material kit and required skill levels; vanilla uses that kit, then any leftovers are removed.
Remove non-floor objects from the pointed square. Protection options are in Brush settings. Back up your save.
Turns off all active cheat modes from this menu.
LMB or N starts fire; F extinguishes. Fire can spread. Esc / RMB returns to the menu.
Changes elevation using the up/down arrow keys. Use on a backed-up save.
Freeze the current clock and calendar date in single player. This is not pause: characters and actions keep moving. Applying a new date/time updates the frozen point. Unfreeze to resume time.
Toggles ghost mode so zombies ignore the player.

Enables native God Mode and the legacy death-prevention health guard under one switch. If native invulnerability is unavailable, the guard repairs health and injuries on updates and damage events. Instant engine-level death can still bypass the fallback.
Fully heals the current character right away.

Speeds up finite timed actions and each batch of inventory transfers in single player. Walking and indefinite actions are unchanged. Normal transfer checks, capacity limits and recipe requirements remain in effect.
How many copies of the selected item to spawn.
Search by display name or full item ID.
Sets every listed skill to the maximum level.
Allows the character to pass through world obstacles. Disable after use.
Removes the equipped ranged weapon's shot delay, not all ammunition or reload requirements.
Refills ammo in the equipped weapon.
Removes optional armor and tuning parts while leaving core mechanical parts in place.
Deletes all zombies in the current loaded area.
Repairs the currently equipped weapon or tool.
Repairs every repairable item in the inventory.
Repairs the vehicle the player is currently inside.
Repairs all clothing currently worn by the player.
Resets all listed skills to zero.
Restores only skills from the saved snapshot.
Restores skills, recipes and tracked statistics from the saved snapshot.
Saves the current skill profile into the character snapshot.
Saves the current skill profile into the character snapshot.
Saves the current character skills, learned recipes and tracked statistics.
Spawns the selected item into your inventory.
Spawns the selected vehicle near the player using the chosen setup.
Protects against negative hunger, fatigue, thirst and similar status loss.
Ammo, damage, durability and weapon maintenance shortcuts.
Quick healing and protection from negative moodles and status loss.
Search any registered item and spawn the required amount.
Player toggles, god/ghost modes and character progress snapshot.
Edit skill levels, then save or restore them on another character.
Delete, fire and terraforming tools for map editing.
Spawn vehicles, preview them and manage vehicle cheats.
Zombie brush and emergency zombie removal.
Paint the selected ground/floor tile with LMB or X. Choose material in Brush settings. Esc / RMB returns to the menu.
Toggles vehicle god mode for the current vehicle.
Hotwiring bypasses the ignition lock so the selected car can start without its key. It does not repair the engine or add fuel.
Basic: a plain spawned vehicle without extra tuning.
Maximum: a fully repaired and prepared vehicle with best-effort extra parts and fuel.
Select an item. Clothing is shown on a 3D preview of your character.
No character snapshot has been saved yet.
Preview shows the vehicle script model. Actual tuning is applied to the spawned/selected vehicle.
Delete and brush tools work on the selected world tile. Turn them off when you are done.
Mouse wheel over the preview to zoom.

Choose a ground/floor tile and press Use tile. The menu hides and its auto-pause is released. Left-click or drag over the map; Esc / right-click returns to the menu. X also paints/removes, Z places barricades, N starts fire, F extinguishes it. The brush works on loaded squares on your floor. Back up the save before editing.
Deletes the selected vehicle and its stored contents. This cannot be undone.
Exit the vehicle before deleting it
The destination is outside the loaded map definitions
Enter a number within the specified range
Unknown sprite ID; use a name such as blends_natural_01_0
Menu language only. AUTO follows the game; Russian, English, French, Spanish and simplified Chinese can be selected explicitly.
This operation is available in single-player only
Locations from the supplied Reloaded catalogue. Their coordinates may differ on custom maps.
Executes Lua in the game client. Only run code you trust. Saved editor text is local to this mod.
No clear square near the player. Move to an open area.
Live appearance: worn clothes, blood and visible injuries. Updated after actions and changes.
This vehicle cannot be configured in the preview renderer. Spawn settings still apply.
Drag to rotate. Use + / - to adjust the view.
Catalogue model — not a configuration preview
3D preview is unavailable. Check the selected model and console.txt.
Click a vehicle in the world. The menu will reopen after selection.
Select a vehicle from the list
Select a vehicle on the map first
Click a segment to set level 1–10. Click immediately to the left of the first segment to set 0.
Changes this character's survival statistic, not the world's date.
Check the destination and its floor before teleporting. A wrong height can cause a fall.
Changes the world's calendar and clock. Make a save backup before large jumps.
Only the selected item is fitted. Your actual equipment is not changed.
Only recognized optional part slots are changed. Custom vehicle scripts may need their own adapter.
This operation is not available in this game build

Moving a slider automatically enables its override. Switch it off to return to natural weather. This panel releases only the menu's automatic pause; the world stays live. Storms develop over game time: disable Freeze time to watch them. Starting/stopping an event clears manual rain, fog, wind, clouds, temperature and humidity, but keeps cosmetic light settings.
Preview only: no animal is placed in the world. Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom.
Unable to render this animal. See trainer diagnostics.
The required settings API is not available.
Settings for other mods by Rax. Only active compatible mods are shown. Disabling hardcore restores the prior profile; multiplayer settings belong to the server.
Only the trainer language changes. The game and other mods keep their language. Language packs may register additional entries.
The native Lua error list is unavailable in this session. Use trainer diagnostics or import console.txt.
No imported console snapshot. Run Support/WatchConsole.ps1 or use Lua errors / trainer diagnostics.
Read-only viewer. Lua errors and trainer diagnostics work in game. console.txt uses the optional local Support/WatchConsole.ps1 importer; no files are sent anywhere. At most 800 lines are retained.
Local green illumination and phosphor overlay. Does not change world weather.
Changes panel backgrounds, not text. 100% is opaque; 35% is most transparent.
Only in single player. Closing restores the previous speed only if this menu paused it. Selecting a world target temporarily releases our pause.
Equipment preview unavailable; see trainer diagnostics.
This developer toggle is session-only in the original mod.
Controlled by the server in multiplayer.
Book XP boost is already active
XP boost disabled; matching skill book reset
No book XP boost at maximum level
Apply book XP boost (x5 for the next two skill levels)
Empty box: no bonus. Triple arrow: boosted (including read books). Click to toggle; disabling also resets the matching skill book.
Choose a free square with ground or a floor.
LMB: paint / drag. Esc or RMB: return to menu.
Paint within 100 tiles, on your current floor.
Fire cannot be placed here; check fire restrictions.
Player-wide mechanics cheat, not a setting of the selected car.
No barricadable door or window on this square.
Some changes were applied, but another operation failed. Check the log.
Show building outlines recorded in the world map data.
Display diagnostic information for world cells.
Show boundaries of map chunks in the collision data.
Show the zombie-intensity distribution used by the simulation.
Display a 256 by 256 tile reference grid.
Display the 300 by 300 tile world-cell grid.
Show real zombies currently loaded in the world.
Show the moving population layer. This does not issue movement orders.
Show collision obstacles used when calculating paths.
An additional renderer layer. Its original identifier is below; no world state is changed.
Show room regions in the collision data.
Show world-sound markers used by the simulation; not an audio-volume control.
Show the stationary population layer. This does not freeze zombies.
Show vehicle markers on the overview.
No server reply. Check that the same mod is installed on the server. The request was not retried; inspect the map before repeating it.
No zombies were created. Check the square and population restrictions.
The server is rate-limiting brush requests.
Waiting for the server to confirm the previous action.
The weather system rejected the event; check the log and other weather mods.

Choose 1–100 zombies per click (default: 1). Start the brush, then left-click a loaded free square or drag across squares. Random outfits; no duplicate spawn on mouse release. Esc / RMB returns to the menu. In multiplayer, server admin and this mod on the server are required.
Protection is still active; it could not be fully disabled. Check the log.
Protection could not be enabled. Check the log.

Kills loaded living zombies within a 50-tile circle around you, on all floors. Uses normal death, leaving bodies and their items. Players and animals are excluded. The menu closes after a successful action to let death animations finish; manual pause is not cancelled.
Could not read the loaded zombies. Check the log.
Wait for the previous server request.

Deletes zombies without creating bodies. Single-player: currently loaded zombies, not the entire world. Multiplayer: loaded zombies within 50 tiles of the server-side player. Existing corpses and map objects stay. Respawn and migration settings are unchanged.

Deletes all zombies on the highlighted tile of your current floor. LMB or drag to delete; X also works. Esc / RMB returns to the menu. Does not delete corpses, animals, players or map objects. Multiplayer requires server admin and the same mod on the server.
Request sent; waiting for the server.
No server reply. The operation was not retried. Check the world before repeating it and install the same mod version on the server.
Wait a moment before repeating a mass action.
Only part of the operation succeeded.
Loaded zombies only. Radius: a 50-tile circle on all floors. Tile brush: your floor only.
Number of crafts: 1–100. Building places one object per click.
Creative unlocks build and craft actions. Each action receives its own temporary full material kit and required skill levels; vanilla uses that kit, then any leftovers are removed.
Vehicle fire or world fire is disabled in sandbox settings.

Requires Vehicle Fire. Ignites the full footprint of the nearest vehicle within 50 tiles on the same floor, without waiting for spread. The menu closes and releases its own pause. Extinguish affects loaded vehicle fires, not burn damage. Single-player.
The nearest vehicle cannot ignite: it may be burnt out, excluded by the mod or in a no-fire area.
Vehicle Fire's ignition API is unavailable. Enable the supported mod and reload the save.
Default: F6. Rebind here or in Keyboard shortcuts. Right-click access stays available. Typing in chat or a text field does not open the menu.
Left-click a destination to teleport to ground level. Drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Esc or right-click cancels. Check that the destination is safe.
The normal world map is unavailable. Check the world's map settings.
No loaded vehicle within 50 tiles on this floor.
The destination bag has no room or rejects this item.
Choose a valid tile and left-click. Normal building rotation applies. Esc cancels.
Transfer only into your own inventory or carried bags.
Press a new key. Esc cancels. Ctrl/Alt combinations are not assigned here.
Marks map areas as known. This is persistent exploration data, not a temporary visibility toggle. It does not load remote terrain.
Select an item to see its original container and coordinates.
This recipe produced no standalone item without inputs. Transformation, fluid or custom recipes may require the normal crafting process.
The item moved, disappeared or is now outside the radius. Refresh the search.
Adds a Rax icon to the vanilla loot panel. Drag from it into your inventory or carried bags. This is a read-only combined view, not a new storage container. Does not require Proximity Inventory.

Scans loaded containers, corpses, bags and vehicle storage within a 50-tile circle, on all loaded floors. Single-click selects; double-click takes the real item. Single-player only. Scanning is incremental.
The vehicle footprint is unavailable or too large.
Some cells could not be ignited.
The game did not disable native instant actions.
Some items could not be repaired. See the console.
Saved between launches. Vanilla keeps native widget styling; compatibility with UI skins depends on the other mod.
Developer mode uses the Burning Vehicles native settings. Shift+I opens the test panel.

A nostalgic interface for fans of the original Cheat Menu. Main commands become right-click submenus; spawners and detailed editors retain their own dialogs. Turn this off under Settings to restore the main window.
Hide the sidebar shortcut. Right-click and the configured hotkey remain available. The icon is visible by default.
Switch to the modern window immediately.
Already restored this equipment snapshot for this character.
Some item types are unavailable. Restore cancelled.
Recover saved equipment after death. Adds items without deleting existing possessions. Once per character per snapshot. Modded item internals may be incomplete.
Equipment partially restored. Check missing slots and the console.
Save all carried items, bag contents, worn clothes, hands and attached items to an independent backup. Replaces previous equipment snapshot.
Game refused noclip. For multiplayer, server permissions are required.
No damaged repairable objects on this tile.

Click or paint over existing damaged doors, windows, barricades and other repairable constructions. Restores health and glass when supported. Cannot recreate completely missing objects. Single player.
Could not save both snapshots. Auto-save will retry; see the console.
Could not freeze the clock. The mode was disabled; see the console.
Remote action confirmed by the target client.
Remote action failed or was rejected.

Server-player actions. Only the actual server administrator can request remote actions. Existing Rax heal/skill/repair handlers are reused on the target client; the module must be installed on both sides.
Player administration is available in multiplayer. Other tabs keep working in single-player.
This panel requires the server administrator role.
No confirmation received. The server and target may be missing this mod, or the connection was interrupted.
Check the selected username and action. Death, bans and role changes can be irreversible. The server validates the target and administrator rights.
Disarms detected building / vehicle alarms. Does not promise to stop an alarm sound already playing.
The menu closes. Left-click a loaded free square to place animals. Right-click or Escape cancels. Existing zombie / terrain brushes are not modified.
Permanently removes loaded animals, including farm animals, on the current floor in the selected radius. It does not remove zombies.
Spawn an animal type and breed, place animals with a brush, or remove loaded animals in a radius. New B42 capability from the supplied mods.
Refuels supported generators, fireplaces, barbecues and campfires in the selected radius. Does not switch them on.
Works only on loaded squares on your current floor. Radius is limited to 30 squares. Corpse removal is permanent; living zombies are not removed.
Enter a non-empty name without control characters (up to 80 characters).
F6 opens or closes the menu by default. Assign one key per action; assigning an occupied key replaces its old assignment. Shortcuts are ignored while typing. Destructive actions cannot be bound.

Named coordinates stored locally. Teleport uses the existing Rax teleport function. GPS displays distance to the selected point without a floating window. Locations are shared between saves; check the map before teleporting.
Finish or disable the active world cursor / brush first.
Removes blood, dirt and wetness from supported carried clothing and the character. Does not heal or repair equipment.
Irreversible experiment. Make a save backup first. Protection modes can block the effect. Confirm the selected action below.
Disable God mode and Prevent death first.
Additional numeric controls only. Existing repair, tuning, colour, rust and part install/remove actions keep their original implementation. Single-player.
Sets food age to zero. Does not remove poison or change cooked / burnt status.
Home coordinates are stored in this character's mod data. Return uses the existing Rax teleport handler, not another teleport implementation.
This new operation is currently available in single-player only.
New tools only: food age and the remaining uses of drainable items. Includes nested bags. Existing repair and durability remain unchanged.
Adds Teleport here to an otherwise unused right-click on the vanilla world map. Existing map menus and symbol editing take precedence. Uses the existing Rax teleport.
Local green illumination and phosphor overlay. Does not change world weather.
This door has no valid key ID.
Home has not been set for this character.
Select a loaded nearby door or window. Restore glass, edit locks or create its door key. Does not replace existing terrain / delete tools.

Population overview (single-player). Drag to pan, mouse wheel to zoom. The switches below show or hide map layers: they do NOT spawn, delete, stop or move zombies. Hover over a switch for its explanation.
Native population renderer is not exposed in this session.
Preset sprite IDs from Reborn's Build list. Select one to send its sprite to the existing Rax brush settings; no second building system is loaded.
Changes character identity and weight, not the existing skills or saved skill profile. Choosing a profession does not grant its starting traits or XP.
Request sent; the server decides whether to apply it.
Marks the world map as known. This does not load distant cells or remove fog inside buildings.
Advanced: changes the shared VehicleScript RPM profile for all vehicles of this script in this session. This is not an individual engine part. Confirm twice. Restore returns the previous profile.

Edit one option after validating its native format. Some settings only affect newly generated areas or require a restart. Current single-player saves are written when the native API supports it; multiplayer requires server rights.
Applied for this session; persistent saving is unavailable.
Based on Rebuild's SmellImmune: clears FOOD_SICKNESS and food-sickness level. Also affects food poisoning. This is NOT invisibility to zombies or a Knox infection cure.
Approximately triples running and sprinting speed. Normal walking is unchanged. Single-player.
Add or remove a selected trait. Uses the game's trait XP-boost update; your existing skill editor and saved profiles remain unchanged. Some trait effects are only initialized on character creation.
Refills supported DrainableComboItem usage to 100%. Does not guess a liquid for empty B42 fluid containers.
